title: Borrowing Without Getting Burned
goal: Understand interest, the total cost of a loan, and credit scores.

cards.text: Interest is the price of borrowing. You pay back what you borrowed, plus extra.

voice.speak_text: Interest is the price of borrowing. You pay back what you borrowed, plus extra. Say next to continue.

cards.text: {indicator}: {group_percent}% of people like you, compared with {benchmark_percent}% overall.

voice.speak_text: {indicator}: {group_percent} percent of people like you, compared with {benchmark_percent} percent overall. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Always ask for the total you will pay back, not just the weekly payment. Small payments can hide a large total.

voice.speak_text: Always ask for the total you will pay back, not just the weekly payment. Small payments can hide a large total. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Paying bills and loans on time builds your credit score, which makes future loans cheaper.

voice.speak_text: Paying bills and loans on time builds your credit score, which makes future loans cheaper. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Before borrowing for school fees or health costs, compare the total cost at a bank, a savings group and a lender.

voice.speak_text: Before borrowing for school fees or health costs, compare the total cost at a bank, a savings group and a lender. Say next to continue.

cards.text: If a loan payment is more than you can spare each month, borrowing will make things harder, not easier.

voice.speak_text: If a loan payment is more than you can spare each month, borrowing will make things harder, not easier. Say next to continue.

cards.text: You borrow 100 and must pay back 130. How much is the interest?

voice.speak_text: You borrow 100 and must pay back 130. How much is the interest? A: 30. B: 100. C: 130. Say A, B or C.
voice.correct_feedback: Correct. 130 minus the 100 you borrowed is 30 in interest.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is A. 130 minus the 100 you borrowed is 30 in interest.

cards.text: Loan one: pay back 120 in total. Loan two: pay 10 a week for 15 weeks. Which costs less?

voice.speak_text: Loan one: pay back 120 in total. Loan two: pay 10 a week for 15 weeks. Which costs less? A: loan one. B: loan two. C: they cost the same. Say A, B or C.
voice.correct_feedback: Correct. 10 a week for 15 weeks is 150, so loan one costs less.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is A. 10 a week for 15 weeks is 150, so loan one costs less.

cards.text: What helps your credit score the most?

voice.speak_text: What helps your credit score the most? A: paying on time. B: taking many loans. C: checking your balance often. Say A, B or C.
voice.correct_feedback: Correct. Paying on time shows lenders you can be trusted.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is A. Paying on time shows lenders you can be trusted.

cards.text: Compare the total cost of a loan, borrow only what you can repay, and pay on time.

voice.speak_text: Remember: compare the total cost of a loan, borrow only what you can repay, and pay on time. Say next to finish the lesson.
